kraken._candle_doc: v8 venue-grounded candles: every mapped asset's 5m bars are re-grounded on Kraken (wash-trading hygiene, Cong et al. 2023 - external reported volume averages >70% fabricated); this is the per-asset REST refresh cadence (150s = half a 5m bar), throttled to 3 fetches/cycle, most-stale first

ccxt._note: read-only public-data adapter (data/ccxt_feed.py); credentials are refused by construction

signal_gates.description: All 5 gates must confirm simultaneously before a signal fires

learned_weights._doc: per-gate predictive-power weights learned from labeled candidates; cold start (per-gate n < min_samples) reproduces naive equal-weight confidence exactly

profit_taking.description: 4-tier scaled exit engine; triggers are scaled by the regime playbook tier_scale
profit_taking._rollback: set vol_scaled=false for exact rev-2 fixed-% behavior

stop_magnet._doc: v8 anti stop-hunt (Osler 2003/2005: stops cluster just past round numbers; sweep wicks overshoot the level then revert): a trailing-stop candidate within band_bps of the nearest round level on its sweep side is nudged to band_bps beyond it - always AWAY from price, ratchet-composed (never loosens a held stop), never blocks an exit. Break-even floor exempt (its contract is locking breakeven+buffer exactly). 0 = off (code default).

give_back._arm_doc: arm_gain_pct set from the honest ledger 2026-07-20 (n=55, movers n=13): MFE p50 0.30 / p75 0.45 / p90 0.72 - the old 1.5 arm sat ABOVE p90, so the ratchet armed once in 55 trades and movers round-tripped (median peak +0.64 -> median close -0.33). 0.6 sits inside the observed envelope (~2x median mover peak); giveback_frac 0.4 then locks 60 percent of peak. Category repair, not peak-fit: any arm in [0.5, 0.8] captures the same mass.
give_back._doc: peak-gain-armed exit floor: past arm_gain_pct lock 60% of the peak move; past tighten_gain_pct lock 75%. Reconstructed from the persisted high_water — restart-safe, ratchet-only.

signal_decay._doc: runner leash: when the entry signal is no longer confirmed in the position direction, chandelier trail distance shrinks by tighten_factor (exits only ever come SOONER)

inventory_coupling._doc: crowded book: fired tiers retire up to (1+max_boost)x the configured close_pct at full inventory pressure

conviction_runner._doc: entry-conviction (Position.confidence = meta p(win) at entry) scales the RUNNER leash: a LOW-conviction winner banks sooner (tighter chandelier trail), a HIGH-conviction winner keeps the full leash to run. One-sided by construction — only tightens, never loosens — so it composes with the ratchet and can only bring exits SOONER (invariant 5 safe). confidence >= neutral_conf, or <= 0 (unknown/restored/synthetic), keeps the FULL leash unchanged; between min_conf and neutral_conf the trail distance scales linearly down to min_trail_mult. This is how the desk lets a high-conviction winner run and cuts a marginal one short — the model's own p(win) decides.

capital_management._pools_doc: THREE PROFIT POOLS on every realized win: savings_pct locked away untouchable; reserve_pct into the drawdown reserve (weekly rollover RP-070: a LOSING week refills its realized loss from reserve into trading cash before the working baseline can shrink - reserve only ever moves INTO cash, savings never moves); the rest stays as reinvestment and compounds sizing. Three-way parity guard: the pcts must sum to 100. Weekly ledger: outputs/weekly_ledger.csv, one signed row per ISO-week close.

risk._stop_round_doc: Osler round-number hygiene: a stop resting within this many bps of a magnitude-relative round level (00/50 endings) is nudged to the safe side of the level (long above, short below) so it exits BEFORE stop-cascade zones, never inside them. 0 disables.

manip_gate._doc: anti-scalp: manip_suspect_score (MAX of spoof / imbalance-whiplash / cross-venue book divergence, [0,1]) becomes a LIVE risk action on NEW entries — no effect on exits. Below downsize_at: unchanged. downsize_at..veto_at: shrink the entry linearly from 1.0x to min_scale. >= veto_at: veto the entry (SZ-045). Conservative defaults so only CLEAR painted-flow/venue-divergence bites; the spoofy liquidity label still hard-vetoes separately.

risk._mark_stale_sec_doc: a mark not refreshed (ticker OR book mid) within this many seconds is STALE: profit tiers, inventory derisk and the equity-peak/hard-stop use only a trusted (fresh + jump-confirmed) mark; the per-position protective stop (an escape) never defers. Generous vs the ~5s fast cycle so a healthy feed never trips it.

exit_escalation.description: Each unfilled exit attempt widens the slippage cap by widen_mult (capped at max_slippage_cap_pct); after market_after_attempts failed attempts the exit goes MARKET. Being out at a bad price beats being trapped at a good one. maker_first_profit_exits: a PROFIT-tier close rests post-only on our own side (sell at ask / buy at bid) on its FIRST attempt to capture the spread instead of paying it, then escalates into this marketable ladder if unfilled; risk exits are always marketable-first.

vol_target._doc: off by default: overlaps LeverageGovernor vol input; enable only after paper A/B

risk_protocols._doc: advanced entry-sizing overlay (risk/protocols.py): product of vol-target, CVaR budget, gap-shock, loss-budget taper and portfolio-heat multipliers, floored at stack_floor_mult; RP-041/RP-051 are hard vetoes. Warmup is neutral (RP-060).

regime.description: Macro regime detection: Gaussian HMM (Hamilton) + TSMOM ensemble, hourly refit on daily candles

liquidity_regime._decay_doc: v8 anti-layering (Stoikov 2018 near-touch information; spoof economics: far size is cheap to paint+cancel, touch size gets executed): order-book imbalance weights each level exp(-dist_bps/decay_bps) vs its side's own best, so painted far-from-touch walls decay out of the ratio. One source of truth - regime engine AND liquidity_model view imbalance read this key. 0 = legacy equal-weight.

market_maker.description: Avellaneda-Stoikov quoter: prices every limit order

pretrade.description: Set maker/taker fees to your actual Kraken tier. 25/40 is the public spot floor - config_guard refuses live start below it unless allow_sub_floor_fees is true. price_exit_leg adds the unwind leg (taker fee + half spread) to the EV cost stack - entries must clear ROUND-TRIP cost, not entry-only.

sim_fill._doc: DRY-RUN passive-fill realism (MP-7). queue_aware gates a resting limit's fill on the depth resting AHEAD of it at its price clearing first (Huang-Lehalle-Rosenbaum queue-reactive / Moallemi-Yuan queue value: state-independent Poisson fills over-credit passive execution and bias candidate labels). Eligible once that depth ratchets down (max of observed shrink and a vol-scaled geometric turnover) to within queue_tol_frac of our own order size; the passive_base_prob*exp(-dist/sigma) draw then applies to the front-of-queue remainder. OFF by default: it changes the DRY-RUN label distribution the model learns from, so enable it consciously and re-baseline the quant gates. Constants lifted from the fill path (overfit discipline). Live path unaffected: the venue owns real queueing.

markout._doc: post-fill mark-out: the empirical adverse-selection meter (execution/markout.py). For each NEW-risk fill, at each horizon the signed post-fill move vs the trusted mark is markout_bps = side_sign*(mark-fill)/fill*1e4. NEGATIVE = the price moved against us right after we filled = we were scalped (the ground truth the risk.manip_gate pre-empts). Measurement only - takes no trading decision. window = rolling obs per asset+horizon; grace_sec = extra time to find a fresh mark before dropping an unmeasured fill.

leverage.description: use_margin=false keeps everything spot (1x). Region cap: Kraken allows max 10x here; pair-level caps may be lower.

position_sizer._vol_doc: vol scaling of the ticket (lifted from buried literals, identical defaults): scalar = clamp(vol_target_ann_pct / max(sigma_annual_pct, vol_sigma_floor_pct), vol_scalar_min, vol_scalar_max). tier_reach_decay: each next profit tier assumed reach_decay x as likely as the previous when deriving the payoff ratio b/b_net (feeds the Kelly breakeven).

inventory_aggression._doc: lean in when the book is light, back off as short-term entry clustering or long-term gross heat builds; linear light_boost->heavy_cut over max(u_long, u_short)

inventory_skew._doc: Avellaneda-Stoikov reservation skew, taker transplant (A-S 2008 r = s - q.gamma.sigma^2; Table 1: ~6% expected-profit cost for >2x lower P&L variance). SIGNED and direction-aware, unlike inventory_aggression (gross/unsigned): only entries that INCREASE net exposure are scaled, mult = max(floor_mult, 1 - gamma.(q.d).(sigma/sigma_ref_pct)^2-amp with amp clamped to [amp_min, amp_max]; inventory-reducing entries are never penalized. mode: off | shadow (log the would-be multiplier, apply nothing) | active. Shadow by default: flip to active only after the shadow ledger shows sensible multipliers on real entries.

sampling._doc: State-Change Sampler: register candidates on state-change EVENTS instead of every confirmed-signal cycle. Symmetric CUSUM on log returns (Page 1954 Biometrika 41:100-115; Lopez de Prado AFML 2018 ch.2 vol-scaled symmetric CUSUM filter; Easley/Lopez de Prado/O'Hara 2012 JPM 39:19-29 information-driven clocks), h = cusum_k * sigma_bar, OR-fused with the bot's own macro/liquidity regime-label flips (a label flip is a new state even with zero net drift). Clock sampling gave mean per-asset label uniqueness 0.06 (2016 rows ~ 120 independent lessons). Calibration on 60h real Kraken 5m data (ETH/BTC/SOL/XRP): k=3.0 -> ~30 events/day/asset, median gap ~45min, implied uniqueness ~0.11 at one-third the row rate; effective-lessons/day is FLAT across k in [1,4] (8h label span bounds it), so 3.0 is a plateau choice, not a fitted peak. Win = state diversity + 3-6x less redundancy, not more raw information.
sampling._bounds: guard: 1.0 <= cusum_k <= 6.0 when enabled (below 1 sigma is clock sampling by another name; above 6 starves the corpus)

ml._label_mode_doc: exit_policy = label candidates/bootstrap by replaying the live exit engine (hard stop max(stop_loss_pct, stop_vol_mult*sigma) + tiered scale-outs + give-back/trailing) so the model trains on the SAME bet it is traded on; set 'triple_barrier' for the legacy symmetric pt/sl barrier (label_pt_vol_mult/label_sl_vol_mult below apply only to that mode).

multi_horizon._doc: SHADOW-ONLY: score each candidate at several holding horizons and log the outcome to shadow_path (never the live label/model). Evidence for whether some asset pairs pay over a longer hold than others - promote a horizon feature only once scripts/horizon_report.py shows a per-asset edge. All horizons must be <= label_max_bars.

exploration._doc: DRY-RUN active learning: take a fraction of confirmed signals as small paper trades so real-fill labels accrue and the cold model can improve. Hard-gated on dry_run; auto-off once until_live_rows history rows exist. SCALE NOTE: on ledgers under ~$5k set size_scale=1.0 - a 0.25 slice of a small kelly ticket falls below min_ticket_usd and every exploration entry gets vetoed (observed at $25k/scale-0.25).
exploration._unwind_doc: learning-phase anti-wedge: when the book is at max_concurrent_positions and NO open position carries a pending label vector (schema gates dropped them), the row pipeline is starved - unwind the oldest such position (one per slow cycle, dry-run only, min age gate) so slots go back to trades that teach. ML-071.
exploration._drought_doc: SIGNAL-DROUGHT extension of the VOI fastpath: with a free slot the fastpath normally stays dormant (a new teach trade can open regardless, holding is free). When NO entry has been admitted for realize_drought_h hours (thin weekend books, sustained gate vetoes) that premise fails - holding buys nothing and costs label latency - so the fastpath arms with free slots too. Clock resets on any successful entry-order submit. 0 disables the extension.
exploration._fastpath_doc: VALUE-OF-INFORMATION fast-forward: the realize horizon only throttles learning when the book is FULL (a free slot admits a new teach trade regardless). Full book -> the stalest position realizes at fastpath spans (0.25 = ~2h, the guard floor) to buy a teach slot with the least label-richness cost; free slots -> the full realize_after_label_spans window (holding is free, outcome richer). Faster live-label flow reaches the evidence gate's floors sooner, unlocking model capacity earlier - compounding, not sloppy: candidate label geometry (label_max_bars) is untouched, live rows carry barrier='realized', and the uniqueness/recency weighting applies as usual. 0 disables the fastpath.
exploration._realize_doc: learning-phase LABEL REALIZATION (ML-073, dry-run only, auto-off at until_live_rows). Fixes the SD-002 starvation loop: exploration paper trades must CLOSE to become live labels, but in a quiet book they hit no tier/stop and sit for days, filling the book to capacity so no new teaching entry can fire (observed: 0 entries, model cold at 35 live rows, retrain requested 18x with no new data to clear it). A position held past the model's LABEL HORIZON (realize_after_label_spans * ml.label_max_bars * bar-seconds; default 1x = ~8h) has already resolved its triple-barrier outcome, so its realized close IS the label the model expects - close the stalest such position (one per cycle) to bank the live label and free a teach slot. NOT a free literal: the horizon is the labeler's own window. Set realize_mature_labels=false to disable.

aggressive._doc: conviction-scaled aggressive exploration (dry-run only). Normal exploration always min-sizes, so the model only sees fill outcomes on timid marginal trades. With probability frac, when the model conviction (real model_p) >= min_conviction AND manip_suspect <= max_manip AND the regime is not crisis, take a FULL-conviction ticket (size on sizing_p, no size shrink, no min-ticket floor) so the model learns from confident calls at real size. Still bounded by every risk-stack veto (CVaR/heat/budget/inventory/leverage), the manip gate, and kelly_cap. Labels stay honest (real fill + real outcome).

monitor._drift_doc: input-drift (ML-031/032) via decile-PSI vs the model's stored training deciles. drift_min_rows=100: a 10-bin PSI needs ~10 samples/bin; a 40-row window fabricated 19% mean / 28% p95 drift from an IN-DISTRIBUTION sample (null-tested), nearly firing the 30% retrain vote on pure noise — 100 rows drops that floor below 5%. Clock/counter features (hour_sin/cos, funding_dist, regime_age) are excluded from the vote in code (ml.features.DRIFT_EXCLUDED_FEATURES): their PSI reads window phase, not market state. drift_frac_features=0.30: retrain only when >=30% of the MARKET features shift beyond drift_psi_threshold=0.25.

postmortem._doc_stop_gap: stop_gap_factor: a stopped-out trade whose realized loss exceeds this multiple of its configured stop distance is attributed to 'stop_gap' (exit engine could not act - runner outage/observation gap) instead of cost_overrun/alpha_wrong, so ops failures never feed the cost or whipsaw governors. Lived 2026-07-14: 1.8% stop filled at -6.9%.

sample_weights._manip_doc: training-hygiene: rows labeled under manipulation-suspect data (manip_suspect feature: spoof/whiplash/cross-venue book divergence, parameter-free max) are down-weighted by (1 - manip_discount * suspect). A painted book teaches the painter's lesson.
sample_weights._uniqueness_doc: AFML ch.4 average-uniqueness correction (Lopez de Prado): overlapping labels on the same asset share the same return path and are NOT independent evidence, so each row's weight is scaled by mean(1/concurrency) over its [signal_ts, ts] lifespan on a uniqueness_grid_sec bar grid. 197 overlapping quiet-weekend candidates stop counting as 197 independent facts. uniqueness_floor bounds the discount so a dense cluster is down-weighted, never erased. Not a fitted knob: grid = the 5-min signal cadence; floor = an order-of-magnitude retention bound.
sample_weights._tb_zero_doc: a candidate zero from the VERTICAL barrier (barrier=='time': price touched neither profit nor stop inside the horizon) is 'no move', weaker evidence against the signal than a realized stop-out; it takes this weight. 1.0 = no distinction (legacy rows with barrier unknown always get full weight). Wu et al. 2020 (Entropy 22:1162): pooling no-touch expiries with directional losses mislabels trend structure.
sample_weights._prior_skew_doc: ML-074 one-sided-batch DETECTOR: if the trailing window_h of labels has a class prior deviating from the corpus prior by more than the threshold (the all-zero quiet-weekend batch), log + flag it in last_load_stats so calibration drift is visible. Detection only - never silently reweights.

interpret._doc: Post-hoc interpretability (scripts/interpret_report.py, ml/interpret.py). REPORT-ONLY analysis knobs, not decision-path tunables: background_rows = history-spanning rows stashed in the model artifact for exact interventional SHAP; corr_cluster_thr = |pearson| union threshold for clustered (Hooker/de-Prado) permutation importance; eval_frac + purge_rows = time-ordered held-out tail; n_repeats = permutation repeats; profile_rows = rows in the attribution fingerprint; drift_cos_warn = fingerprint-rotation cosine below which the report flags attribution drift.

adaptive_gbt._doc: OPT-IN top ladder rung (ml/models.py AdaptiveGBT): bagged, warm-updatable boosted trees. Ships DISABLED - like every new learner it enters the DEPLOYED walk-forward selection only when enabled=true, and even then must beat mlp out-of-sample by the Brier margin to ship (the ladder is evidence-gated). Two upgrades over the single gbt rung, both free of any FITTED degree of freedom: (1) bags decorrelated boosted-stump models on different seeds and probability-averages them (pure variance reduction, exactly what ensemble_seeds does for the MLP); (2) warm_update() appends up to warm_rounds boosting rounds per member on freshly labeled rows between full retrains - continuous learning that leans recent by construction, hard-capped at max_total_trees so it can never grow unbounded. Enabling it changes the deployed selection rule: re-run scripts/overfit_check.py to re-baseline (OF-3 PBO reads this flag), and note the champion/challenger Brier gate is then the only thing between an adaptive_gbt champion and the live paper runner.

model_selection._doc: EVIDENCE GATE on the walk-forward selection ladder (ml/walkforward.admissible_families). Model capacity needs a minimum sample-per-effective-parameter to generalize instead of memorize (events-per-variable floor, Peduzzi 1996); a boosted-tree / MLP / bagged ensemble fit on a handful of real outcomes can only overfit, and entering it into selection just manufactures a lucky winner (inflating PBO). So a higher-capacity family is TRAINED and entered into selection only when BOTH floors clear: min_live_rows (real closed-trade labels - complexity is earned on ground truth, not triple-barrier proxies) AND min_total_rows (enough labeled rows to fit non-degenerate purged folds). logistic (the linear baseline) is always admissible and defines the simplicity floor. Floors escalate with capacity; they are order-of-magnitude sample-size floors, NOT tuned to any backtest peak. overfit_check mirrors this gate so OF-3 PBO measures the space the bot actually selects from. enabled=false -> no gating (historical behavior).

sentiment.description: Free multi-source sentiment (Google News RSS per figure, crypto news RSS, Hacker News crowd via Algolia public API). FILTER ONLY - shades risk/confidence within clamps, never triggers trades. No API keys.
sentiment.figure_keywords: bitcoin OR crypto OR ethereum OR markets

system._cycle_fail_halt_doc: consecutive whole-cycle (cycle_once) failures the runner tolerates before it latches a NEW-RISK halt and fires one loud alert. Exits still run every cycle (invariant #5); the runner never auto-flattens on a wedge (a transient feed outage must not dump the book) nor self-terminates (a deterministic fault would relaunch-storm). At ~5s polling, 10 = ~50s of a wedged loop before halting new entries. Cleared by an operator resume, not by a lucky cycle.

websockets.description: Push-based Binance.US depth stream (data/ws_feed.py), read-only cross-venue depth for BTC/ETH. OFF by default: Binance.US's ws is geo/proxy-blocked from the Anthropic cloud container (Connection reset by peer, endless reconnects, shows 'disconnected'), and the Kraken v2 ws below already delivers the real-time execution-venue books. Enable this ONLY when running on the always-on PC, where Binance.US ws connects and adds sub-second cross-venue depth; REST is the always-on fallback regardless.
websockets.kraken_note: Kraken v2 public book channel (wss://ws.kraken.com/v2). Real-time incremental books for the 6 trading_pairs, keyed by Kraken REST pair so fast_cycle's get_order_book(pair) reads the cache and skips the rate-limited REST Depth loop. Read-only public data; Kraken execution stays on the REST order path (invariant 3). Fail-safe: stale/down/disabled -> REST.

webdata.description: Free keyless crypto context: CoinGecko global (BTC dominance, mcap) + alternative.me Fear & Greed index.

thales.description: Lazy-bot insecurity model (docs/THALES.md): detects grid ladders, clock-driven MM quoting, significance-gated scheduled flow, and stop-cluster sweeps from public data. influence=shadow records advice without applying it; advise applies bounded confidence shading only.

reliability._doc: V2 evidence-weighted gains: every closed advise-mode trade grades the detectors that shaded its entry (up-advice vindicated by a win, down-advice by a loss). Below min_fired grades a detector keeps its full configured gain (the hand-crafted prior rules cold start); after that the gain is scaled by max(0, 2*WilsonLCB90 - 1), so a detector that cannot beat a coin flip out-of-sample loses its voice. Weights ATTENUATE only, never amplify. feed_integrity is exempt (safety shade, not an alpha thesis).

spoof._doc: TH-017 spoof/layering flicker (Cartea-Jaimungal-Wang: spoofing operates through top-of-book imbalance; its snapshot footprint is a level >= big_ratio x median top depth that vanishes >= drop_frac while the mid never crossed it - pulled, not consumed). Per-side EWMA (decay per fast snapshot); entries whose direction the flickering side baits are shaded down past score_thr. SAFETY shade: exempt from V2 reliability grading.

barclose._doc: TH-015: no-code/indicator bots evaluate on candle close; their activity clusters in the first seconds after bar boundaries (intraday periodicity). Buckets top-of-book change events by phase-of-bar; score = excess share of bucket zero.

feed_integrity._doc: TH-014: shade an asset's entry confidence DOWN when its book feed shows a sustained rate of missing/sanitize-rejected data (hostile or unreliable venue). Softer, per-asset complement to the watchdog's hard staleness block. window=recent fast cycles tracked; min_obs before it judges; dirty_frac_thr=rejection fraction above which shading engages; gain=shade strength.

lapse._doc: TH-016: observation-lapse hygiene, distilled from the 2026-07-14 incident (container restart + proxy outages: hours-long gaps in our own observation stream were treated as continuous, and advice ran on stale evidence at full confidence). fast_gap_sec=gap between clean book observations above which continuity state resets and advice mutes; warmup_sec=mute duration while the detector bank re-warms; bar_gap_bars=candle hole (in units of observed bar spacing) that fences swing/sweep context; clock_skew_tol_sec=backwards-clock tolerance before a time regression counts as a lapse.

smc.description: Smart Money Concepts structural features (docs/SMC.md): multi-timeframe trend alignment, premium/discount zone, liquidity-pocket pull, fair-value-gap pull + confluence, volume-profile POC/Value-Area position. Pure feature computation added to the meta-model's feature vector - never a gate, never a veto, never sizes or times an order.

circuit_breaker._doc: per-asset consecutive-loss circuit breaker: after loss_streak FULL-trade losses in a row on one asset, NEW entries on that asset are vetoed (SZ-046) for cooldown_hours, then it auto-resets (a win resets the streak any time). Early, local protection the portfolio-level budgets react to late; exits are never touched (invariant 5).

skimmer._doc: asset skimmer: scan a candidate pool beyond the core trading_pairs, rank tradability (spread cost / book depth / bar activity), and PROMOTE the best into the active universe at the NEXT RESTART (runner.main merges outputs/skimmer_active.json into trading_pairs on the live path only - replay/overfit stay pinned to the recorded universe). Core pairs are permanent; at most max_extra promotions, keeping the worst-case REST-fallback budget (3 req/s with WS down) inside the ~12-pair envelope. Watching costs <=2 REST calls per evaluation, one candidate round-robin per loop pass, each at most once per eval_every_min. Promoted assets face every existing rail (EV gate, sizer, protocols, heat, firewall, manip gate); demotion only removes them from the NEXT boot - open positions keep their exits. apply_in_live=false means promotions apply in dry-run only until explicitly enabled for live.

moomoo.description: Read-only cross-asset quotes via moomoo OpenAPI (quote context only - execution impossible). Requires local OpenD gateway + pip install moomoo-api. Disabled by default.
moomoo._opend_path_doc: full path to OpenD.exe on THIS PC (e.g. C:/moomoo OpenD/OpenD/OpenD.exe). When set AND moomoo.enabled, pc_supervisor launches OpenD if opend_host:opend_port isn't listening and keeps it alive with the bot. Leave empty to manage OpenD yourself. OpenD must be set up for headless/auto-login (its own config) to serve the port without a manual GUI login. Env LB_OPEND_PATH overrides this.

watchdog.description: Tail-event sentry: stale-data trips, cross-venue divergence, rolling PnL-velocity circuit breaker, single-tick quarantine, live equity-truth drift. Any trip blocks NEW entries; exits are never touched.

risk_firewall.description: Independent last-line checks on EVERY order (15c3-5 style): price collar vs reference, absolute + pct-of-equity notional caps, per-minute rate limit, duplicate suppression. Entries reject on breach; exits are clamped, never blocked.

alerts.description: Out-of-band operator alerting for CRITICAL events (halts, watchdog trips, equity drift, dead-man failures). POSTs JSON {text, content} to any Slack/Discord-compatible webhook. Disabled by default; alerts always land in the log regardless.

assurance.description: Assurance Build spine: hash-chained audit trail (outputs/audit.jsonl), latching fault manager, global reason codes, model registry (outputs/models/). All rewritten modules log every reject/clamp/fault/deploy through the chain. Verify integrity anytime: python scripts/assurance_check.py

strategies._rollback: set engine to five_gate to restore the rev-1 gate stack

urgency._doc: urgency = base + w_burst*burst + w_fresh*fresh + w_delta*delta, clamped [0,1] (lifted literals, identical defaults). Drives the execution ladder: join/improve/taker thresholds live in execution_tactics. fresh_decay_evals = streak span over which edge freshness decays to zero.

informed_flow._rev3: continuous evidence fusion; rollback via strategies.engine=five_gate

execution_tactics._thin_doc: thin-book precision entries (adverse-selection defense): when thin_book_maker_only is true, an entry into a 'thin' liquidity regime is forced maker-only (never crosses the spread) and rests improved thin_improve_spread_frac into the spread for a precise fill. Ships false = current behavior; enable to trade thinner weekend books safely without paying the toxic-book spread.

execution.description: rev-4 institutional execution layer: parent/child algo scheduling, venue routing, transport groundwork

algos._note: flip true to slice large entries; children reuse the full hardened order path

routing._invariant: kraken-only execution; any other venue here is FATAL in live (config_guard) and screamed in dry

fix._note: codec + session bookkeeping shipped (execution/fix_codec.py); live FIX requires institutional onboarding — see docs/EXECUTION_CONNECTIVITY.md

venues._note: Unified VenueAdapter registry (execution/venue_adapters.py). Kraken is the sole execution-eligible venue by invariant; every other adapter is registered but disabled and can NEVER be execution-eligible. Enabling one is a deliberate act: set enabled, populate *_env with the environment-variable NAMES holding credentials (never the secrets themselves), add the venue to execution.routing.eligible_venues, and clear config_guard. Withdrawals/transfers stay on the permanent deny list on all venues.

ibkr._note: Interactive Brokers Client Portal / TWS gateway

dma._note: Sponsored Direct Market Access behind a broker 15c3-5 line

ccxt._note: CCXT-fronted exchange EXECUTION (data feed is separate, public-read-only)

fix._note: Raw FIX 4.2/4.4 acceptor; codec in execution/fix_codec.py

grpc._note: optional grpcio; generate stubs per api/liquiditybot.proto. auth_token mirrors rest.auth_token: when set, every RPC must carry matching x-auth-token metadata
